## Checklist

- [ ] No real employee or candidate data, anywhere, including notebook outputs
- [ ] Legal or regulatory claims cite a primary source (statute, court order, regulator page)
- [ ] Any prompt or skill change says whether it was tested on a model, and if so which model, when, and what changed
- [ ] Internal links resolve (CI checks this)
- [ ] No em dashes, no jargon that only makes sense inside one company
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated if this is user-visible
